fine.timing_scope: dispatch wall time only; excludes native import and earlier geometry preflight. Full-load phase includes final convergence, recovery and result construction, not a standalone cold full-load benchmark.

conclusions: Both runs completed and passed the predeclared physical checks. The repeated load targets are bounded continuation attempts, not a hang.
Most dispatch time precedes target1:86.38% coarse and90.45% fine. Only6.33/4.72seconds remain after entering full load, including recovery/reporting.
There are29/28 rejected initial targets before six accepted stages. Each rejected target assembles one43-group tangent; all target reductions differ from generic halving.

Pinned source identifies those reductions with the first-Newton predicted-rotation safeguard (5deg), before a line-search update. The finite soft hinge and its nearly unloaded path drive the startup search; rank/initialization phase is below1.3seconds.

No final strip is stalled: maximum cl is about.4613, with at least.6886 margin to its nearest literal stall limit. Final-state evidence does not alone prove every derivative perturbation or accepted intermediate trial unstalled.

The logs do not partition mechanical versus aerodynamic CPU inside tangent assembly. The cause of the repeated attempts is mechanical/branch protection, while each coupled tangent still evaluates aerodynamic terms.

Local force-point velocity grows from50.05 to148.35m/s near the inner side of the folding joint as the mesh refines; root moment changes.7322%, above.1%. Keep this separate from startup cost and do not smooth it by an arbitrary core.

Emit stage acceptance/rejection in progress so users see why load decreases.

Do not hardcode the successful4.4e-5 fraction from this fixture. Preserve unscaled hinge residuals, physical acceptance, chart tracking and existing final tolerance.

Localize root-moment coarse/fine differences and near-joint force-point velocities using saved strip forces, positions and endpoint traces before another mesh or setting sweep. Do not claim the aerodynamic discrepancy is caused by startup continuation or that a core/settings change is justified.
